events.label: Mount Tambora Eruption
events.fact: Caused global climate anomalies leading to the "Year Without a Summer".

events.label: Yellowstone National Park Established
events.fact: First national park in the United States, spanning Wyoming, Montana, and Idaho.

events.label: Yosemite National Park Established
events.fact: Protected California's Yosemite Valley and Mariposa Grove.

events.label: Kruger National Park Proclaimed
events.fact: One of Africa's largest game reserves, located in northeastern South Africa.

events.label: Passenger Pigeon Last Individual Dies
events.fact: Martha died at the Cincinnati Zoo, marking the extinction of the species.

events.label: Tasmanian Tiger Last Captive Death
events.fact: Last known thylacine died at Hobart Zoo in Tasmania.

events.label: Serengeti National Park Established
events.fact: Famous for its annual wildebeest and zebra migration in Tanzania.

events.label: Golden Toad Last Sighting
events.fact: Brightly colored amphibian of Monteverde cloud forest last seen in 1989.

events.label: Pinta Island Tortoise Lonesome George Dies
events.fact: Last known individual of the Pinta tortoise subspecies died in the Galapagos.
